kind: analyze (read our staged LDA+U VASP records for the three CrN structural variants: relaxed cell parameters, spin-resolved Cr-Cr exchange-path distances, relative energies, fundamental gaps, Cr moment)
provenance: Every truth below was re-derived independently by the grader author from the STAGED files alone (agent/relax/CONTCAR, agent/static_{i,ii,iii}/{OUTCAR.gz,EIGENVAL.gz}) with reviewer/make_reference.py -- self-contained parsers, no pymatgen, no reuse of the reproduction's analysis code. The same script wrote reference_submission/answer.json. Cross-check against 3_reproduction/L3/result.json: every field agrees to <= 8.1e-5 absolute (the largest, gap_iii, is result.json recomputing the gap from 4-decimal-rounded VBM/CBM: 10.1410 - 9.6317 = 0.5093 versus the raw 0.509381). See 3_reproduction/L3/index.md and context.md.

conventions.cell: a, b, c are the norms of the CONTCAR lattice vectors in file order; the first vector is the stacking axis. Reading the same quantities from static_iii/POSCAR gives the identical numbers to 6 decimals.
conventions.internal_coordinate: x_Cr and x_N are the fractional coordinate along the stacking axis of the one site of that species in 0 < x < 1/4 (declared pin 2 in notes.md; the 4c site has four equivalent x values in the cell).
conventions.exchange_classes: Twelve nearest Cr neighbours of a Cr site in the relaxed cell, classified by the sign of the product of the two site-projected moments read from static_iii and by multiplicity. Every Cr site sees the same inventory {parallel x4, antiparallel x4, antiparallel x2, parallel x2}; the 13th neighbour is at 4.14 A, far outside the shell.
conventions.energies: 'free  energy   TOTEN' of each static (ISMEAR = -5, so TOTEN, energy-without-entropy and energy(sigma->0) are all equal to the printed precision), divided by 4 formula units in the eight-atom cell, in meV, positive when the reference cell lies higher.
conventions.gap: min unoccupied minus max occupied Kohn-Sham eigenvalue over the run's own k set, both spin channels (declared pin 1). Occupancy > 0.5 counts as occupied; the band-counting reading (NELECT/2 = 34 filled bands per spin) gives the identical value in all three statics.
conventions.moment: mean |site-projected moment| of the four Cr ions from the last 'magnetization (x)' block of static_iii (LORBIT = 11 PAW site projection; RWIGS is ignored); all four are 2.850 muB with the +--+ pattern.

primary.note: PRIMARY, all 15 fields. Binary all-primary-pass (handbook 1(1)). Missing field, non-numeric or non-finite value scores 0 before any check runs (handbook 1(3)).

tolerance_rationale.relative_0.10: handbook 2(1), the universal scalar band. Applies to the two energy differences, the three gaps and the Cr moment.
tolerance_rationale.relative_0.005_lattice: DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION (handbook 2(5)). +/-10% on a is 0.58 A, which would pass the unrelaxed cubic seed (a = 5.855 A, 1.4% away) and even a wildly wrong cell. 0.5% is the reproduction's own G1 fidelity tolerance (result.json guards.G1_table_I_geometry.tolerances.a_b_c_fractional = 0.005) and gives bands of 0.0289 / 0.0148 / 0.0207 A on a / b / c -- 20x our own deviation from the source table (~0.027%), so a correct relaxed answer has ample margin while the cubic seed fails on a.
tolerance_rationale.absolute_0.002_x: DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION (handbook 2(5)). +/-10% on x_Cr is a 0.0135 band, but the whole physics of the displacement is a 0.010 shift from the ideal 1/8, so the relative band would pass an undisplaced answer (x = 0.125). 0.002 absolute is the reproduction's own G1 tolerance (guards.G1.tolerances.x_Cr_x_N_absolute) and is ~100x our own deviation from the source table (2e-5).
tolerance_rationale.absolute_0.01_distance: DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION (handbook 2(5)). +/-10% is 0.29 A while the four classes span only 0.114 A, so the relative band cannot tell the classes apart and a class swap would pass. 0.01 A is twice the reproduction's own G1 distance tolerance (0.005 A -- and our own deviations are <= 0.9 mA), and still ~10x below the class spread, so any confusion of the parallel and antiparallel 4-fold shells fails.

designed_wrong.note: The readings a competent-but-mistaken agent produces; each must score 0. Verified in reviewer/selfcheck.py.

per_cell_energies.why: total-energy differences not divided by the 4 formula units (4x the truth, far outside the 10% band).

doscar_threshold_gap.why: the gap read as the width of the sub-threshold window of the staged DOSCAR around E_F instead of from the eigenvalues. MEASURED on the staged DOSCARs (make_reference.py): the tetrahedron DOSCAR grid step is ~0.21 eV, so variant i reads 0.000 eV (the DOS at E_F is 0.1555 states/eV, above the threshold), variant ii reads 1.039 eV and variant iii 0.831 eV -- all three outside their 10% bands (0.056 / 0.057 / 0.051 eV). This confirms necessity arm (b) of declared pin 1.

swapped_4fold_classes.why: d_parallel_4 and d_antiparallel_4 exchanged (2.873 vs 2.987 A): a geometry-only reading that never looks at the moments. |diff| 0.114 A, 11x the 0.01 A band.

x_as_half_minus_x.why: the site in 1/4 < x < 1/2 reported instead of the one in 0 < x < 1/4 (declared pin 2).

total_cell_moment.why: the net cell magnetization (-0.000 muB, the AFM sum) reported instead of the site-projected Cr moment (declared pin 3).

unrelaxed_cubic_lattice.why: the variant-i cubic lattice reported as the relaxed cell; a is 0.079 A away, 2.7x the 0.0289 A band.

negative_moment.why: the signed moment of a down-spin Cr reported where the prompt asks for the magnitude (sign is part of the value, handbook 2(1)).

accepted_alternatives.note: Correct readings that differ from ours in presentation only; each must score 1. Verified in reviewer/selfcheck.py.
accepted_alternatives.result_json_rounding: the values as printed in 3_reproduction/L3/result.json (gaps recomputed from 4-decimal VBM/CBM: 0.5581 / 0.5731 / 0.5093).
accepted_alternatives.two_decimal_lattice: a, b, c rounded to 2 decimals (5.78 / 2.97 / 4.14) and the distances to 2 decimals -- inside the 0.5% and 0.01 A bands.
accepted_alternatives.static_poscar_structure: the cell and internal coordinates read from static_iii/POSCAR instead of relax/CONTCAR (identical to 6 decimals; a genuinely alternative source file for the same quantities).
accepted_alternatives.extra_fields: extra keys beyond the schema are ignored, not failed (handbook 1(3)).

score: 1 only if all 15 PRIMARY field checks pass; any single failure scores 0 (binary all-primary-pass).
